reason: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/controllers/create_account_controller.js:274-276, the guard only checks result.errors && result.errors.email && result.values without checking result.values.email, so pushObject(result.values.email) pushes null, undefined, or an empty string into rejectedEmails when values.email is omitted or blank (which app/controllers/users_controller.rb:199 can return via user.attributes.slice("name", "username", "email")).
